Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

O Coordenador de CRM terá um papel estratégico no fortalecimento da área como peça-chave na performance do negócio, liderando projetos transformacionais que integram dados, comportamento de consumo e performance. Atuará na construção de jornadas mais inteligentes e personalizadas, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da base ativa e o fortalecimento da nossa marca. title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description:
Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI

Light – Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).
Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

title: Principal Product Engineer, Americas
description:
Overview

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as individual contributors—where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

We believe in ownership and autonomy, with engineers taking end-to-end responsibility for projects. You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. Examples of how product engineers at Ashby contribute include:

  • Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app.
  • Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
  • Spec’d, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby.
What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. TA software didn’t help. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling.

We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

  • You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure.
  • You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity and thrive at the intersection of the two.
  • You know how to balance speed and quality. We moved with urgency, while delivering a high-quality product that encouraged customer adoption.
  • You’re ambitious and open to feedback to level up.
  • You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator and can work with stakeholders to ship products.
  • You seek to create leverage in your work through automation and abstractions.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You view tech leads or principals as project managers and require sign-offs.
  • You need company-wide processes to drive your projects.
  • You only want exciting work and dislike customer issues and investigations being distributed across the team.
  • You get lost in details and prefer everything planned upfront.
  • You haven’t led or owned projects before.
  • You want to mentor many junior engineers; our team is largely senior and mentorship opportunities are limited.
Engineering Culture

Our culture is grounded in ownership and collaboration. We aim for a small, talented team that can ship high-quality software fast and maintain reasonable work hours. We focus on:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers deliver magical outcomes with minimal oversight while keeping stakeholders informed. We prefer engineers who own their problems end-to-end rather than rely on heavy processes.

Technology Stack

TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis. Experience with these is not required, but a love of typed languages helps. Engineers who have switched from other languages are welcome; what matters is fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget

description:
Assistente de Farmácia (Glória)

Descrição
Assistente de Farmácia para atuar em nossa clínica oncológica, oferecendo suporte às atividades técnicas e administrativas da farmácia. O profissional será responsável por auxiliar no controle, organização, armazenamento e dispensação de medicamentos e materiais, assegurando a conformidade com as normas de segurança, rastreabilidade e boas práticas em oncologia.

Principais Atividades
  • Apoiar o farmacêutico nas rotinas de dispensação e conferência de medicamentos oncológicos e de suporte.
  • Realizar o recebimento, armazenamento e controle de validade de medicamentos e materiais hospitalares.
  • Executar lançamentos de entradas e saídas no sistema de gestão hospitalar.
  • Separar e preparar kits de medicamentos para quimioterapia e infusões sob supervisão do farmacêutico.
  • Manter atualizados os registros de controle de temperatura e umidade dos ambientes e equipamentos da farmácia.
  • Realizar o controle de estoque e inventário periódico.
  • Apoiar o processo de devolução, descarte e rastreabilidade de medicamentos.
  • Garantir a organização, limpeza e cumprimento das normas sanitárias da área.
  • Apoiar no atendimento aos setores assistenciais (enfermagem, consultórios, infusão) para fornecimento de materiais e medicamentos.
  • Cumprir as políticas de segurança, biossegurança e boas práticas de armazenamento e dispensação.
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso técnico em Farmácia completo ou cursando (obrigatório).
  • Experiência prévia em farmácia hospitalar ou clínica, preferencialmente em oncologia.

  • Noções de boas práticas de armazenamento e controle de medicamentos.

  • Vivência em farmácia oncológica ou manipulação de quimioterápicos.

  • Familiaridade com controle de temperatura e cadeia fria.

description:
Job description

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Main responsibilities

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Supervisionar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe de atendimento garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados e o cumprimento dos diversos indicadores da área;
  • Acompanhar e analisar os relatórios dos indicadores da área (nível de serviço, tempo médio de atendimento, tempo médio de espera, aderência etc);
  • Monitorar os canais de comunicação utilizados pelos clientes para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e nível de satisfação;
  • Realizar uma análise crítica dos clientes (detratores) apontados na NPS buscando um acompanhamento diferenciado;
  • Acompanhar e planejar diariamente as atividades da equipe bem como o seu gerenciamento: contratação, demissão, avalição, feedback, acompanhamento de férias, ponto e banco de horas;
  • Elaborar campanhas motivacionais e ações de reconhecimento, engajamento e valorização do colaborador;
  • Realizar interface com as diversas áreas da companhia para solução de problemas e melhorias de processos.
Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Sólida experiência com gestão de equipe;
  • Bons conhecimentos do Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos;
  • Perfil antenado as boas práticas de mercado e com visão estratégica sobre experiência do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no horário das 09:00 - 18:00;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação de forma híbrida (de 4 a 8 vezes presencial por mês), no Rio de Janeiro.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

description:
Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes.

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Cumprir as rotinas determinados pela a área de Enfermagem, quando referente ao acompanhamento e condução de pacientes.

Ter idade mínima de 18 anos. Ensino Médio Completo.

Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência na função de Maqueiro.

Jacarepaguá, RJ

Horário de trabalho: 07:00 - 19:00 ou 07:00 - 19:00

Carga horária: 36 horas semanais.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

  • Share options to make you feel like an owner

  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, para conhecer os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo! Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único! Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nossos ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

description:

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical

Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.

Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.

The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.

If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

What your day will look like

  • Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
  • Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical's current and future products.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
  • Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
  • Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
  • Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you

  • B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
  • Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
  • Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
  • Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
  • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
  • Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A equipe de Metadados tem como principais funções a catalogação dos datasets e atributos de toda a empresa, gerenciamento de bases de log dos produtos e gerenciamento de bancos de dados otimizados.

O time em que essa pessoa ficará alocada é responsável por cuidar dos logs dos produtos, estruturando a arquitetura necessária para armazenamento e gestão destes logs e as interfaces necessárias para os times de produto interagirem.

  • Colaborar com as demais equipes técnicas para entender os diferentes tipos de usos para os logs de produtos;

  • Desenvolver ferramentas e interfaces para facilitar a visualização, busca e análise de dados.
Requisitos
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada;

title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
description:
Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you
  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem
  • Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.
What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction and engineering sectors.

Hybrid schedule, from 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM (Brasilia time)

Our Recruitment Consultants are responsible for supporting the global talent banking practices of qualified multi-sector candidates that match the experience, skill set, and knowledge of client job requirements that the Delivery Centre supports globally.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Ensure all candidates screened possess the correct skillset, experience, and qualifications.
  • Use all available resources and networks to successfully source new candidates (Job Boards, LinkedIn etc) for active and prospective opportunities.

  • Report on lead generation performance, demonstrating accountability and commitment to identifying new opportunities.
  • Maintaining and developing relationships with new and existing candidates within their assigned industry and/or discipline.

  • 2+ years of recruitment experience.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre o Banco de Talentos

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo. Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias.

Criamos o Banco de Talentos para acelerar o processo de recrutamento e seleção, trazendo maior transparência para os candidatos, e mais agilidade para o time interno trabalhando com este processo. Se você curtiu e se identificou com a nossa empresa, inscreva-se em nosso Banco de Talentos! Seja a primeira pessoa a ser considerada para oportunidades na BDC.

Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de integração contínua/entrega contínua (CI/CD) no Gitlab;
  • Realizar monitoramento, escalabilidade e automação de processos de implantação;

  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a entrega de software;

  • Participar na configuração e gerenciamento de recursos em ambientes AWS;
  • Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada como DevOps em um ambiente de TI, com ênfase em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Proficiência em Terraform para laC;
  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;
  • Conhecimento sólido em monitoramento e soluções de automação;
  • Familiaridade com integração das pipelines com ferramentas de análise de código e segurança, como, por exemplo, Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe

Será um diferencial

  • Conhecimento em ZapProxy, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center;
  • Certificações relevantes da AWS

O que oferecemos

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

description:
Lead Talent Partner at Synamedia - We are Hiring! | Master's in European Studies and International Relations

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You'll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

description:

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA!

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos.
Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente!

SUSHIMEIRO
Escala: 6x1
Tipo de contrato: CLT

MISSÃO DO CARGO:
Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

ATIVIDADES DO CARGO:
• Manipular e higienizar os produtos, observando a qualidade e a validade dos itens, a fim de garantir o aproveitamento máximo dos insumos evitando desperdícios sem comprometer a qualidade
• Preparar sushis e sashimis, além de outros tipos de refeições do cardápio oriental definido pela empresa, separando e selecionando o produto a ser utilizado, garantindo a qualidade e satisfação do cliente
• Realizar a higienização do local de armazenamento, garantir o correto acondicionamento das mercadorias e verificar a qualidade e validade dos itens em estoque
• Seguir as normas estabelecidas pela Vigilância Sanitária e Manual de Boas Práticas

REQUISITOS:
• Ensino fundamental completo
• Experiência Anterior

INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE
Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.
Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual.

Alimentação no local

Plano de saúde

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Nossa Missão:
Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

Nossos Valores são:
• Jogo aberto e íntegro
• Foco em resultado com qualidade
• Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso
• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser
• Atitude Responsável

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!

Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.

Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.
Our Values
  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary and transparent expectations.
  • Share options to foster ownership.
  • Home office budget, hybrid remote work (around São Paulo).
  • Personal development and language allowances.
  • 40 days of annual leave.
  • Autonomy to innovate and impact.
  • Bi-annual team offsites in Brazil.
  • Equipment such as laptops.
Compensation Philosophy

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

Application Process

Approximately 8 hours over 4-6 weeks, including multiple interviews, references, and profiling. Follow us on LinkedIn and subscribe to our newsletter for updates.

How to Apply
  • Submit your CV in English unless justified otherwise.
